1: The newer Bespoke Saints English (1).pdf governs, with accepted Genesis 1–11 as the English benchmark. It supersedes the older Founding Style Guide where their pronoun rules conflict: Thou/Thee/Thy/Thine address God directly; ordinary address uses you/your.

Ordinary plural address and modern third-person verbs restored. Trials and temptation remain distinguished by context (1:2,12–14); 1:13 is rendered cannot be tempted by evil. Complete is retained across 1:4,17,25; act of giving distinguishes the giving from the gift in 1:17. The divine Father-of-lights image, conception and birth, firstfruits, mirror, bridled tongue and unstained religion remain. Become doers in 1:22 restores the imperative’s becoming language. Past narrative forms in 1:11,24 are retained; 1:25 is smoothed without removing doing/hearing contrast.

The fire simile in 5:3 now modifies devouring flesh, matching displayed NA28 punctuation, rather than treasure storage. In 5:6 He does not oppose you replaces the inherited question, matching displayed NA28 declarative punctuation. Modern verbs and ordinary you address restored. Lord Sabaoth, the day of slaughter, early/late rain, doors, Job, the sick person, oil, confession and prayer remain. The prayer participle in 5:16 stays when it is at work without adding emotional fervor; Elijah’s emphatic prayer and three years six months remain.
